ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixel distribution with approximately 5-8% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage across the visible ventral area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve profile fitting the path from the median notch to the distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct diagonal and intersecting linear high-intensity pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the right lobe surface; one prominent horizontal scratch on the central-left region.
